title: Reading Packet Captures: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A packet capture is a recording of what crossed the wire. Reading one is a skill the exam now tests. Let's learn to spot the clues.

scenes.heading: The postal investigation
scenes.narration: Each type of packet leaves a clue. A R P requests with no reply point to a layer two problem. I C M P type three code four means the packet needed fragmenting. One time exceeded message is normal, since that's how traceroute works. T C P retransmissions point to loss, or to a slow receiver.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It might be a VLAN or a host issue. Traceroute causes them too. They can mean other things.

items.wrong: No ARP reply means the IP is wrong
One Time Exceeded means a loop
